expectations.text: Covers AB 2246: repeals/replaces the Age-Appropriate Design Code with a reasonable-steps framework — default ban on profiling minors, opt-in consent structure, dark-pattern prohibitions
expectations.evidence: "AB 2246: replaces the Age-Appropriate Design Code with a 'reasonable steps' framework. Profiling of minors is banned by default. Dark patterns aimed at minors are banned." The default-ban-unless-consent structure is reinforced in the action list ("Stop profiling minors by default. Document any exception under AB 2246"; "unless you hold opt-in consent").

expectations.text: Covers AB 1709: bans addictive features (personalized algorithmic feeds, autoplay, push notifications) for users under 16, with penalties up to $50,000 per affected minor
expectations.evidence: "AB 1709: bans addictive features for under-16s. Personalized feeds, autoplay, and push notifications are the named features. Penalties reach $50,000 per minor."

expectations.text: Covers the chatbot pair: SB 1119 (companion-chatbot child-safety duties — risk assessments, crisis protocols; core obligations July 1, 2027) and SB 867 (ban on companion-chatbot toys, sunsetting 2031)
expectations.evidence: Both bills are named with correct dates ("SB 1119: companion-chatbot child-safety duties. The core obligations begin July 1, 2027"; "SB 867: bans companion-chatbot toys. It sunsets in 2031"), but the SB 1119 substance — risk assessments and crisis protocols — is never mentioned. Compound assertion not fully met.

expectations.text: Gets effective dates right: January 1, 2027 default for the package (signed September 10, 2026), with SB 1119's later core date
expectations.evidence: "California's September 2026 children's package... Most of it takes effect January 1, 2027", "The package (signed September 10)", and "July 1, 2027 for companion-chatbot duties."

expectations.text: Gives compliance advice: age-assurance posture (AB 1856 OS signals), feature audits for under-16 experiences, profiling defaults
expectations.evidence: "AB 1856... Plan to consume the OS-level age signal"; "Audit engagement features. List personalized feeds, autoplay, and push notifications, and plan under-16 variants that are off by default"; "Stop profiling minors by default."
